unavailable_semantics: Public struct layout/export information is not included in MIR function facts.
Generic and dyn trait calls do not identify every concrete runtime callee.
Dependencies, build scripts, proc macros and Cargo feature configurations are not executed.
Other rustc versions are unsupported because textual MIR has no stable interchange guarantee.
